{{Top|leg}}
The '''Wind Master''' was the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] responsible for maintaining the giant turbines that supplied electricity to the city of [[Kala'uun/Legends|Kala'uun]] on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. The Wind Master and his extended family maintained and cleaned the turbine generators, electrical supply conduits, and storage capacitors. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the position of Fan Master was held by [[Wrou'shak]].
